sources.title: GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored model | NanoGPT
sources.snippet: GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored is an uncensored fine-tune of the efficient 320B mixture-of-experts reasoning model, built for unrestricted chat, creative writing, coding, agentic work, tool use, and long-context tasks.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash by Z.ai | Model Library | Modal
sources.snippet: GLM 5.3 Flash GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series: a 320-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters per token and a one-million-token context window, built for coding and agentic work.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Model Overview GLM-5.3-Flash is the first native multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, delivering stronger intelligence than GLM-5.2 at an exceptionally low cost. Highly Efficient Hybrid Architecture GLM-5.3-Flash has 320B total parameters with 18B activated.
